answer: Every extra clone doubles the bill. The delta is a registry whose channels merge any identities sharing a payout address, gas source or code fingerprint. To be seated there, the n-th falcon in a channel must lock 2^(n-1) wander, a fixed-supply bonded token, slashed in full if the channel is proven to be one operator. An honest agent locks 1 wander, but a channel holding twenty clones has locked 1,048,575. The defence fails only if each falcon can look unrelated cheaply or wander becomes cheap to buy.
